skill.name: when-deploying-cloud-swarm-use-flow-nexus-swarm
skill.description: Deploy Flow Nexus cloud swarms with event-driven workflows, monitoring scripts, and scaling guidance for distributed AI agents.
skill.summary: Deploy and monitor Flow Nexus cloud swarms for distributed AI agent workflows.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline command formatting, or benign memory key names. The skill still has real operational risk because it runs mutable external CLI packages and defines unattended cloud auto-scaling automation.

remediation.suggestion: Pin npx package versions and verify package integrity before running Flow Nexus or Claude Flow commands.
Require human approval, budget limits, and audit logging before any agent spawn or swarm scaling action.

remediation.issue: Generated shell scripts parse external tool output
remediation.suggestion: Validate swarm IDs, workflow IDs, metrics, and agent counts before passing them to shell scripts or MCP commands.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable External CLI Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells users to run npx commands with latest and alpha tags. Mutable package tags can execute changed third-party code in the user environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands explicitly use npx with latest and alpha tags. That creates a clear supply-chain risk unless versions are pinned and verified.

semantic_findings.title: Unattended Cloud Auto-Scaling Loop
semantic_findings.description: The generated auto-scaling monitor runs indefinitely and calls Flow Nexus scaling commands based on metrics. This can increase cloud resource usage without an approval gate.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The loop is explicit and includes mcp__flow-nexus__swarm_scale calls. The script has bounds, but no human approval or budget guard is shown.

content.value_statement: Distributed agent deployment can be hard to coordinate and monitor. This skill provides a structured Flow Nexus process for swarm setup, workflow execution, metrics, and scaling.
actual_capabilities: Defines a five-phase process for Flow Nexus cloud swarm deployment.
Creates topology, agent, workflow, monitoring, and scaling configuration files.
Uses Flow Nexus MCP commands for swarm, agent, workflow, and metrics operations.
Adds Claude Flow memory and hook commands for coordination state.
Provides bash monitoring scripts for agents, workflows, performance, and scaling.
Documents success criteria and memory keys for each deployment phase.
limitations: Requires a configured Flow Nexus MCP server and authenticated account.
Some steps require E2B or cloud resources that may create costs.
Commands use external CLI tools and should be reviewed before execution.
The workflow examples need adaptation for production security and governance.

use_cases.title: Launch a prototype swarm
use_cases.description: Set up a small Flow Nexus swarm with defined topology, agents, and monitoring artifacts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate multi-agent workflows
use_cases.description: Create event-driven workflow definitions and assign cloud agents to staged development tasks.

use_cases.title: Monitor and scale agent capacity
use_cases.description: Collect metrics, generate reports, and apply scaling policies for active cloud swarms.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic swarm
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a first Flow Nexus deployment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a hierarchical Flow Nexus swarm with four agents and basic monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Create workflow assets
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate files for agent roles and workflow routing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create topology, agent specification, and workflow files for a development swarm.

prompt_templates.title: Add monitoring and reports
prompt_templates.scenario: Operationalize a running swarm with metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add agent monitoring, workflow tracking, performance reports, and memory persistence.

prompt_templates.title: Review production readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before running cloud automation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit the deployment steps, identify approval gates, and adapt scaling limits for production.

output_examples.input: Deploy a hierarchical cloud swarm for a full-stack workflow.
output: A topology plan with coordinator, supervisor, and worker roles.
A workflow execution plan with monitoring and success checks.
A scaling policy that defines thresholds and agent limits.

output_examples.input: Add monitoring to an existing Flow Nexus swarm.
output: A monitoring script plan for agent metrics and workflow status.
A performance report outline with utilization and error metrics.
Memory keys for storing metrics and phase completion state.

output_examples.input: Prepare a production review for cloud swarm automation.
output: A list of commands that need human approval before execution.
A review of scaling limits and resource cost exposure.
Recommendations for pinning CLI versions and validating outputs.

best_practices: Pin external CLI versions before running deployment commands.
Add human approval before creating, scaling, or destroying cloud resources.
Validate all IDs and metrics returned from memory or MCP tools.
anti_patterns: Do not run the auto-scaling script unattended in a paid cloud account.
Do not copy example credentials or IDs into production workflows.
Do not expose Flow Nexus, E2B, or Anthropic credentials in generated files.

faq.question: What does this skill deploy?
faq.answer: It guides deployment of Flow Nexus swarms, agents, workflows, monitoring scripts, and scaling policies.

faq.question: Does it require Flow Nexus?
faq.answer: Yes. The process depends on Flow Nexus MCP tools and an authenticated Flow Nexus account.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Claude Flow commands and supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Will it create cloud costs?
faq.answer: It can. The skill includes cloud agent deployment and scaling steps that may consume paid resources.

faq.question: Is it ready for production use?
faq.answer: Not without review. Add pinned versions, approval gates, logging, and limits before production execution.

faq.question: Does it include monitoring?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines agent, workflow, performance, and auto-scaling monitoring scripts.
